messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE — Okafor settlement
messages.plaintextBody:
WITHOUT PREJUDICE

Dear Sarah,

Further to your letter of 28 April, our client will not accept £95,000 but, in a genuine effort to compromise, would now accept £105,000 plus an agreed reference, mutual confidentiality and a contribution of £1,500 + VAT to her legal costs. This is a significant move from £165,000 and is open for 7 days.

Rachel

messages.subject: RE: WITHOUT PREJUDICE — Okafor settlement
messages.plaintextBody:
WITHOUT PREJUDICE

Dear Rachel,

Thank you. Our client is prepared to meet your client's principal terms but not the figure. Our client will pay a total termination payment of £115,000 (£30,000 taxable in respect of notice and holiday, and £85,000 by way of compensation, the first £30,000 of which to be paid free of tax), together with the agreed reference, mutual confidentiality and non-derogatory terms, and £1,500 + VAT towards your client's costs. This is our client's best offer and is made to achieve a clean break. Open for 7 days.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment & Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0820

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
